recipes.name: King of The Hill Special
ingredients: For The Spa Peggy and Meatballs
10 Granny Smith Apples, cored and sliced
instructions: For The Frito Chili Pie
Start by putting the cans of chili into a pot, covering and bringing to a bare simmer. - 2 can Chili with Beans
Butter up a large glass pie plate.
Add a layer of chili to the bottom of the pie plate followed by a layer of Fritos, a layer of cheese, and another layer of chili. - 2 cans Chili with Beans - 1 bag of Fritos - Cheese
Place in the oven at 375°F for 20 minutes.
Remove from oven and top with another layer of cheese followed by a layer of Fritos. - 1 bag of Fritos - Cheese
Place back in the oven for 5 minutes.
Remove and let cool for 5 minutes.
Serve and enjoy!
For The Spa-Peggy and Meatballs

In a large glass bowl combine the ground beef with the egg and breadcrumbs, a splash of milk, a few dashes each of garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, dried basil, salt, and pepper. Add a healthy sprinkling of parmesan cheese. Mix to combine. - 1 lb Ground Beef - 1 Egg - ½ cup Bread Crumbs - Splash of Milk - Garlic Powder - Onion Powder - Dried Basil - Oregano Powder - Salt - Pepper - Parmesan Cheese
Roll into balls and bake at 400°F for 15-20 minutes.

In a large pan add the diced onion. Let it sweat for a few minutes before adding the clove of minced garlic. Let cook for a minute or until fragrant before adding the can of crushed tomatoes. Let simmer for 30 minutes and then add a pinch of sugar. Stir to combine. - 1 Onion - 1 cloves Garlic - 1 can Crushed Tomatoes - 1 pinch of Sugar
Add meatballs to the sauce and make sure they’re well coated. Cover and cook for 15-20 minutes.
In a pot cook some store bought spaghetti and when it’s just about done cooking, reserve ½ a cup of pasta water. - Spaghetti
Strain pasta.
Remove meatballs from sauce.
Add your ½ cup of reserved pasta water back to the pasta before adding your sauce. Mix to combine.
Add spaghetti to a bowl and top with meatballs and additional parmesan cheese.
For The Apple Brown Betty

In a bowl, combine the brown sugar with ground cinnamon, ground ginger, allspice, and ground cloves. Mix to combine. - ½ lb Brown Sugar - 1 tsp Ground Cinnamon - ½ tsp Ground Ginger - ¼ tsp Ground Allspice - ⅛ tsp Ground Cloves
Core and slice granny smith apples. - 10 Granny Smith Apples cored and sliced
Butter your casserole dish and add in about half of your sliced apples. - 5 Granny Smith Apples cored and sliced
Sprinkle with some of your brown sugar mixture and then top that with some breadcrumbs. - Breadcrumbs
Add the rest of your apples, the rest of your brown sugar mixture, and some more breadcrumbs. - 5 Granny Smith Apples cored and sliced - Breadcrumbs
Slice a whole stick of butter into thin slices and place them on top of the breadcrumbs so they cover the whole surface of the apple brown betty. - 1 stick of Butter
Cover and bake at 375°F for 20 minutes. Uncover and bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let cool for 5 minutes, serve and enjoy!
